name: product-management
description: Project-local managed-coworker for product work across a fleet of Cloudflare-hosted sites. OAuth-only harness, operator-picked connectors via enum, no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Forked from anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/product-management with SEO-native skills added for agentic-traffic work.

analytics.title: Analytics connector(s)
analytics.description: Which analytics MCP server(s) to enable. Operator picks at install/devcontainer-rebuild time; only selected servers start via Docker Compose profiles.

search_console.title: Search-console connector
search_console.description: Search-console MCP server (Google Search Console). OAuth refresh-token lives in Cloudflare Secrets Store, never in env.

chat.title: Chat connector
chat.description: Team chat MCP server (Slack / Discord / Telegram). Notification surface for digests.

project_tracker.title: Project tracker connector
project_tracker.description: Project tracker MCP server (Linear / Asana / GitHub Projects). Where roadmap items land.

feedback.title: User-feedback connector
feedback.description: User-feedback MCP server (Intercom / Cannylinks / GitHub Issues). Source for synthesize-research.

site_portfolio_path.title: Site portfolio JSON
site_portfolio_path.description: Path to the operator's site-portfolio.json — the list of (zone-id, hostname, niche, target-keyword) tuples for site-portfolio-pulse / seo-audit / content-gap-brief. Defaults to packages/knowledge-work-plugins/product-management/site-portfolio.example.json.
